title: Phase 4: Workspace re-org (collapse to single binary crate per repo)
description:
v0.1.0 blocker.

Scope: (1) mdatron: collapse mdatron-core + mdatron-cli into single mdatron crate; reorganize into src/main.rs + src/commands/{init,verify,explain}/mod.rs + src/dsl/ + src/schema.rs + src/diagnostic.rs + src/frontmatter.rs + src/embedded.rs. (2) vsdd: collapse vsdd-core + vsdd into single vsdd crate; reorganize into src/main.rs + src/commands/{init,verify,observe,...}/mod.rs + src/artifacts.rs (the embedded 42-markdown + 4-schema + 1-pattern + 6-template artifacts) + src/preflight.rs + src/mdatron.rs (from Phase 3). (3) Apply anyhow at binary edges (main.rs); keep typed-variant errors at module boundaries. (4) Single Cargo.toml per repo; drop [workspace] section. (5) Update cargo install discovery convention.

Acceptance: cargo build produces single binary per repo; all existing tests pass after migration; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings clean.

Per docs/refactor/binary-first-plan.md Phase 4. Blocked by Phase 3 (vsdd subprocess client must land before vsdd-core/vsdd merge).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
UN-STUCK (operator direction 2026-07-28). Rescheduled from 'the mdatron session's cycle / when the collapse schedules' to land WITH the engine/Slice-1 work (phase-2a). No longer a perpetual punt.

SCOPE CORRECTION: the FULL single-crate collapse in this issue's title is SUPERSEDED for vsdd -- the cost crate (Slice 7) requires a workspace, so vsdd stays a 2-crate workspace. The actual pending act is narrower: REMOVE the vsdd-core crate by merging it into the vsdd binary crate, leaving {vsdd, cost} (the #739 2026-07-22 marker: 'both cores planned for removal').

WHY HERE: the engine (ratified #819) IS the re-characterized vsdd-core -- state/snapshot/derivation/queries -- plus the binary's renderings; and Slice 1 already rewrites acquire.rs inside vsdd-core (the tracker-join). Merging the crate boundary away while that code is being touched is the natural moment; the slice's crate-level module map is a phase-2a act per #819, so the merge is decided/executed there.

VSDD SUB-QUESTION DECIDED: the cost crate keeps the vsdd workspace (yes -- it is why full collapse is superseded). The other #739 sub-question (whether mdatron's single crate keeps a lib target) is mdatron's, excluded here.

CONTRACT TOUCH: the Architecture-section workspace-shape paragraph ('this paragraph takes its amendment when the collapse schedules') now takes that scoped amendment -- ROUTED to an owned cycle (bundle with the terminology follow-on, or the Slice-1 phase-1a/1b entry), never solo-hand-edited. Issue title is now inaccurate for vsdd (full-collapse wording); retitle to 'vsdd-core removal (merge into the vsdd binary crate; cost workspace retained)' when convenient.
